It's a delicious meal, dessert-like.
Feb 2026 • Family
It was supposed to be for Pink Church.
Turns out the dishes were more surprising than the seats.
The church doesn't have the shock of Hanoi watching.

Beef tarta with freshly roasted toast.
And bovine bone marrow must be eaten!
Fat and not greasy. Fresh ingredients.
I brought the brata cheese salad for degreasing, and it didn't work out at all.
And of course it tastes good.

Sitting still after dinner, my sister recommends afternoon dessert.
Personally, I don't think the dessert is as stunning as the dish.
No wonder people think of the store as average.
The four inside mango towers are the best.
